SPECIFIC PROCUREMENT NOTICE Request for Bids Plant Design, Supply, and Installation (Without Prequalification) (Two-Envelope Bidding Process with rated criteria) Country : Ukraine Project : Ukraine – Improving Power System Resilience for European Power Grid Integration (Installation of Hybrid Systems for Electricity Production in Ukrhydroenergo) Contract Title : Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Kyiv HPP / PSP, Kaniv, Kremenchuk and Seredniodniprovska Hydropower Plants, including related services (training of UHE staff) (hereinafter referred to ‘the Contract’) comprising the following lots: Lot 1: Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Kyiv HPP / PSP, including related services (training of UHE staff) (46 MW BESS capacity). Lot 2: Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Kaniv HPP, including related services (training of UHE staff) (66 MW BESS capacity). Lot 3: Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Kremenchuk HPP, including related services (training of UHE staff) (60 MW BESS capacity). Lot 4: Design, Supply and Installation of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Ancillary Equipment at Seredniodniprovska HPP, including related services (training of UHE staff) (25 MW BESS capacity). Source of financing: IBRD Loan No.: 9284-UA; CTF Loan No.: TF0B5994; CTF Loan No.: TF0C5903-UA; and CTF Grant No.: TF-0B5724. Project ID : P176114 RFB reference No .: UHE-IPSR-DSI-1 1. Private Joint Stock Company “Ukrhydroenergo” (PJSC “Ukrhydroenergo” or UHE) has received financing from the World Bank (hereinafter referred to as the “Bank”) toward the cost of the Project “Ukraine – Improving Power System Resilience for European Power Grid Integration (Installation of Hybrid Systems for Electricity Production in Ukrhydroenergo)” and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the Contract. Under this Contract, UHE intends to make payments using the Direct Payment disbursement method, as defined in the World Bank Disbursement Guidelines for Investment Project Financing. 2. PJSC “Ukrhydroenergo” now invites eligible Bidders to submit Bids for the Contract. Bidders can bid for any one lot, more than one lot or all the four lots . The Time for Completion shall be between 420 and 510 calendar days from the Effective Date of the Contract. No credit will be given for early completion, and Bids offering a Time for Completion exceeding 510 days shall be rejected. 3. Prospective Bidders shall meet the following minimum qualification requirements: (a) General Experience: Experience in activities related to the design, supply and installation of equipment for energy infrastructure facilities, including generating facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and MV and HV grids, under contracts in the role of contractor, subcontractor, or management contractor since at least January 2020. WB-OP00473300.title: Local Hydropower Engineer – full-time 12 months
WB-OP00473300.description: Zletovica Productivity through Irrigation and Renewable Energy. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (CONSULTING SERVICES - INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT - LOCAL) Republic of North Macedonia Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Economy Zletovica Productivity through Irrigation and Renewable Energy Project (PIREP) Grant No.: TF0D2152 Assignment Title: Local Hydropower Engineer (full-time, 12 months) Reference No.: PIREP-IC-08 The Republic of North Macedonia has received financing from the World Bank, acting as trustee of the Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP), for the preparation of the Zletovica Productivity through Irrigation and Renewable Energy Project (PIREP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Water Economy (MAFWE), through its Project Implementation Unit (PIU), is responsible for implementation of the grant. The preparation grant supports the updating of technical and hydraulic studies, dam safety documentation, transboundary-water analyses, and environmental and social instruments for Phases II and III of the Zletovica Hydrosystem, comprising irrigation development and hydropower generation. The PIU implements the grant in close coordination with the Public Enterprise for Water Management Activities HS “Zletovica”–Probištip (PE HS Zletovica), which provides technical leadership, data, access to facilities and institutional support. The objective of this assignment is to provide PE HS Zletovica and the PIU with senior technical advice and engineering oversight for the preparation and early implementation of the Phase III hydropower investments, while ensuring their integration with Phase II irrigation investments and the existing multipurpose system. The Engineer will help ensure that the investments are technically sound, economically and financially justified, safe, climate-resilient, construction-ready, operable and maintainable, compliant with applicable national requirements, and aligned with World Bank requirements. The consulting services ("the Services") include supporting hydropower-related procurement and, when formally appointed, providing technical input as a member of evaluation committees; reviewing feasibility studies, hydrological and energy-yield analyses, detailed designs, technical specifications, bills of quantities, cost estimates and bidding documents; optimizing hydropower schemes; reviewing electro-mechanical and electrical systems, SCADA, grid interconnection and commissioning arrangements; coordinating hydropower development with irrigation, drinking-water supply, reservoir operations and dam safety; integrating environmental and social requirements; supporting approvals and permits; reviewing consultant and contractor outputs; conducting site inspections; supporting construction, testing, commissioning and handover; and providing appraisal inputs, reports and capacity building. The Engineer will report technically to the Director of PE HS Zletovica. The PIU Coordinator/Project Director will serve as the contract-management focal point and provide administrative oversight and coordination on procurement, fiduciary, environmental and social matters. The assignment will be full-time for twelve (12) months during the GFPP-funded preparation period. The duty station will be the offices of PE HS Zletovica in Probištip, with regular travel to project sites and, as needed, to Skopje or other locations for coordination meetings, inspections, testing and commissioning activities. Any continuation into project implementation will be subject to satisfactory performance, project approval, financing availability, and a contract extension or new contract, as applicable. The complete Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are included in Annex 1 to this Request for Expressions of Interest and form an integral part of it.
